GenAiPlugin.description: Identify opportunities to suggest additional services based on customer queries.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: First, check the services that the customer currently has using the 'Get related Services' action. Then, review the services data library to determine if there are any additional services that can be suggested based on the customer's query.
If there is a scope to suggest any new service call the action create opportunity for add on service

GenAiPlugin.scope: My job is to determine if the customer query indicates a potential need for additional services and suggest relevant add-ons.
